summary: At segment 0 step 95, the first meeting with the peaceful quest leader prints the first-time greeting but omits C’s under-level rejection, Wisdom exercise and expulsion. The JS branch calls unsupported and stops; C quest.c:chat_with_leader continues through badlevel, exercise(A_WIS, TRUE) and expulsion(FALSE).

source.branch: In chat_with_leader, after the first-meeting or repeat pager and after confirming the hero remains on qstart_level, when not_capable() is true (u.ulevel < MIN_QUEST_LEVEL), C emits qt_pager("badlevel"), exercises Wisdom upward, then expels to the parent dungeon with expulsion(FALSE). JS currently refuses this exact branch after the matching leader_first pager.
callers: cmd.c:dotalk -> sounds.c:dotalk/dochat -> sounds.c:domonnoise; MS_LEADER dispatches quest.c:quest_chat, whose leader ID branch calls chat_with_leader. JavaScript cmd.js -> sounds.js:dotalk/dochat/domonnoise -> quest_chat -> chat_with_leader.

monmove.c:dochug calls quest_talk for a waiting adjacent quest monster; quest.c:quest_talk -> leader_speaks -> chat_with_leader. JavaScript monmove.js -> quest_talk -> leader_speaks -> chat_with_leader. This is a second active caller; this recording exercises the explicit #chat/quest_chat path.

evidence: challenges/evaluations/accepted-26748832bec4c8d55150cd96f4f870355f5d2bbd-v53.json at 26748832bec4c8d55150cd96f4f870355f5d2bbd records 95/153 screens, 4724/7082 RNG calls and 95/153 cursors for this case; the admitted manifest locates the first mismatch at step 95.

The immutable input sequence uses #chat at steps 90-93, answers the direction at step 94, and the C recording emits the first-meeting greeting at step 94 and the under-level rejection at step 95. The matching steps before 95 precede the missing exercise RNG and parent-dungeon expulsion.

Upstream quest.c:321-336 establishes met_leader/not_ready, returns if no longer on qstart_level, then the not_capable branch calls qt_pager("badlevel"), exercise(A_WIS, TRUE), and expulsion(FALSE) in that order. All three callees already have active JS implementations: questConversation().pager dispatches to qt_pager, exercise(A_WIS, true, state, ops.random) is used by the adjacent badalign and worthy branches, and expulsion(false, ops) calls the existing schedule_goto path. Their C return values are void/discarded; the task introduces no new state owner or return-valued dependency.
